notes: Cut = 10 s from t=113 s of the 531 s film (USPIS_Web_of_Deceit.ogv, 36,971,959 bytes, kept in the folder). Licence basis: US federal government work (17 USC 105) plus the archive.org item's Public Domain licence field; the upload is by a third party (FedFlix), and the film also holds some foreign street shots that may be stock, which are NOT in this cut.
